name: Jellyfish-Neural/01
title: All 171 neurons, tracked

names.ref: Hand annotation (72 neurons; held back for checking)
names.untrained: CoTracker3 as released, from the model's mark
names.label_free: CoTracker3 fine-tuned on the model's marks, from the model's mark

about: The model marked 171 neurons in the first frame; no person clicked anything. It then followed 38 of them, one mark every 10 frames (green rings), and the marks of 28 neurons that nobody annotated trained the tracker. Each tracker starts every neuron from the model's own mark. 70 of the marked neurons are among the 72 that were annotated by hand, and the score beside a tracker is its accuracy on those, in the video's own pixels (mean share of frames within 1, 2, 4, 8 and 16 px). Neurons without a white circle were not annotated, so their tracks cannot be scored. The annotation was held back: only its first frame was read, to keep annotated neurons out of training.
